From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Sudden p99 spikes + 500s since 18:00 UTC

On it. Quick telemetry notes from the initial sampling (18:00–19:00 UTC):
- Elevated GPU memory fragmentation observed on pool-3 (nvlink-8/attached) with frequent small OOMs on ephemeral worker-ids w-3xx.
- KV-cache hit-rate dropped ~22% leading to heavier decode work and longer tail latencies.
- Error signature consistent with transient cudaAlloc failures followed by worker restart.

Short-term mitigations implemented (18:20–23:00 UTC):
1) Forced compaction on affected hosts (reclaim small free blocks).
2) Temporarily scaled pool-3 by +30% capacity to reduce per-GPU pressure.
3) Enabled per-customer routing to spillover pool (lower-cost model variant) for finflow-prod.
4) Switched kernel selection to memory-conservative path for 1 hour.

Still need:
- The request IDs Anita shared (we have partial list). Please upload full list to the drive link so we can pull traces.
- Confirmation from FinFlow on whether batching or longer prompts started prior to 18:00.

I'll follow up with a short postmortem once we have the full trace set.

Rishi
Senior SRE — Redwood Inference
